test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

and ‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

How is Q related to N if N - D × P + Q & C?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 &
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Brother
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: N - D × P + Q & C

It means: N is the Father of D, D is the Brother of P, P is the Mother of Q, Q is the Sister of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a8bee0dbfe8ab42e5e2db4056642699b41e3331ff92479b8eb164e3af175eb39.png] 

So, 'Q' is Daughter’s daughter of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
